day of the breaking of the scythe, as from this date onward no more trees were cut down, and therefore it was a celebration for the trees. The Gemara adds: From the fifteenth of Av onward,
one who adds to his nightly Torah study will add
and he who does not add [mosif] will be gathered [ye’asef].
